entities.summary: Angelo Massarelli (1510–1566) was the Roman Catholic Bishop of Telese o Cerreto Sannita (1557–1566). He is best known for keeping the Acts of the Council of Trent, which were the minutes of the council, and published only 300 years after the council was held.
